---
title: "invalid_scope"
description: "`ctx.execute(..., { scope: \"state\" })` was called where no state can own the call."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** `ctx.execute(..., { scope: "state" })` was called where no state can own the call.

**How to fix it:** Make scoped calls from a state's message, timer or `enter` (not `exit`, not a top-level handler of an actor without states).

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
